what_this_is: F-8b: the PUBLIC benchmarks' integrity on the rebuilt mixture, and the held-out finding F-8 produced, stated in one place.

instrument.exact_identity: sha256 of the whitespace-normalised prompt, against the benchmark's own question text
instrument.residual_overlap: v2/gate_v2.py::overlap_scan, imported — 13-gram Jaccard plus verbatim-span containment, with the gate's own thresholds

held_out_finding.what: 499 of the 500 rows of the v1/v2 held-out set (v2/holdout500.jsonl) are inside the training corpus, complete with their reference answers, in the fenrir stream — 604 rows, because some appear two or three times
held_out_finding.why: the holdout split was applied to the Trendyol copy of CyberSec-Dataset_escaped.jsonl (the v2 gate's admitted candidate) and never to the Fenrir copy (AlicanKiraz0/Cybersecurity-Dataset-Fenrir-v2.1), which was fetched on 2026-09-29 for the v3 build and never passed through the v2 admission gate
held_out_finding.scope: the held-out set is a programme battery rather than a public one. It is retired under the programme's evidence rule, and no public number rests on it. The public benchmarks are measured separately in this file
held_out_finding.fenrir_own_report_gap: data/v3/fenrir-v2.1/CONTAMINATION_REPORT.md reports 'contaminated rows: 0' over 99,870 rows, and also reports that its SecQA fingerprint file was a failed-download placeholder and was excluded — so the zero covers CyberMetric-500 only, and this file measures the SecQA half properly
